familiarity.no: I had never heard of drones
familiarity.term: I had heard the term but was unsure what it meant

core_questions.text: Before today, how familiar were you with drones?
core_questions.organisation_text: Before today, how familiar were you with drones?

core_questions.text: In your own words, what is a drone?
core_questions.organisation_text: In your own words, what is a drone?

core_questions.text: What have you heard about drones carrying goods, if anything?
core_questions.organisation_text: What have you heard about drones carrying goods, if anything?

core_questions.text: What difference, if any, could these deliveries make to people or local services?
core_questions.organisation_text: What difference, if any, could these deliveries make to people or local services?
core_questions.optional_clarification: You can mention helpful changes, difficulties, or no change.

core_questions.text: Before this session, have you had any direct experience, learning or involvement related to delivery drones? If yes, briefly describe what you did.
core_questions.organisation_text: Before this session, what experience or involvement have you had with delivery drones? Describe what you did, or an activity of the organisation you represent, and say which you mean.
core_questions.when_exposure_already_reported: You mentioned an earlier activity. What did you do or contribute during it, if anything?

core_questions.text: What would you like to know more about?
core_questions.organisation_text: What would you like to know more about?

core_questions.text: What would help you take part in discussions or decisions about delivery drones?
core_questions.organisation_text: What would help you or the organisation you represent take part in discussions or decisions about delivery drones? Say which you mean.

probes.text: Are these statements about the same activity and period, or different experiences? You can say if you are unsure.
Can you explain why that effect might occur?
What did you do or contribute during that activity, if anything?
Were those experiences about drones or another service?
Do you know whether anything changed following your contribution?

definition.text: A drone is an aircraft without a person on board to pilot it. It may be controlled remotely or fly using automated systems.
